trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.desc: Complete Gone Fishing.

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when it ends.
Gone Fishing is the first Jason mission after the prologue, in the Leonida Keys.
No special requirement: finishing the mission is enough, it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.desc: Complete Chapter 1.

steps.t: Finish every Chapter 1 main mission, from Gone Fishing to Discharge Time.
Chapter 1 follows Jason in the Leonida Keys and builds to Lucia's release.
The trophy pops at the end of Chapter 1; story trophies cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.t: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation FIRST: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia walks to the balcony at Jason's house in the morning and invites you to meditate — accept at once.
That balcony spot is Chapter 1 only and is not marked on the map like the other spots; after Chapter 1 it is gone.
Then meditate at the 9 marked spots (Smooth Sand, Swamp, Worn Stone, Red Rocks, Water Wheel, Jutting Cliff, Waterfall, Seaside, Ascent Mountain), each with both Jason and Lucia for 2 counts.
You can play as both characters after Chapter 2, mission Coffee Break; each spot counts twice, once per character.
Ascent Mountain, the final spot on Mount Kalaga, only appears after every other meditation is done.
Track it in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; 15 of 18 count for 100%, all 18 for this trophy.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: the Chapter 1 meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot, so it may NOT be required — the final meditation may count +2 to reach 18/18.
disputes.b: GM Treks and KeenGamer: the balcony meditation IS required; miss it and the trophy is gone.
disputes.c: Our call: do it in Chapter 1 anyway. It costs one minute and removes the whole argument.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.t: Learn fishing in Chapter 1: the mission Recalibration teaches casting (hold R2), hooking (R2 on the bite) and reeling (right stick).
Read the Fishing Magazine in Jason's shed; it marks fishing spots on the map and the bait each one wants.
Cal texts a photo of a big fish after Lucia's Release and challenges you to land a bigger one in the same area — beat his catch.
Keep the fish you land; rarer catches fight harder, so use the right lure for the spot.

disputes.a: GTA6-Life: Cal's challenge opens after the mission Lucia's Release in Chapter 1.
disputes.b: KeenGamer lists Cal's fishing challenge as a Chapter 1 activity with no fixed mission trigger.
disputes.c: Our call: start fishing with Cal the moment his challenge text arrives; the chain is safe after that.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.desc: Complete an arcade game.

steps.t: Find any of the 4 arcade video games in Leonida and finish one full game.
Arcade games also count toward the Master of None activity list, so do one early.
No score target is needed — completing the game pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.

steps.t: Try one of each of the nine activities: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, arcade game, winning a race, and a stunt.
Fishing opens with Cal in Chapter 1; hunting opens with Bret's Veteran Hunted in Chapter 2.
Golf has 2 regular courses (King Gator, Frontier Adventure) plus 3 mini golf; pool has 7 opponents; basketball hoops are all over Leonida.
A stunt is any of the 397 stunt spots; the shooting range needs only one challenge attempt.

disputes.a: PowerPyx, GTABase and the card/activities guides agree the nine are: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, arcade game, winning a race, stunt.
disputes.b: Older pre-release lists named bowling and darts instead of hunting and golf — no published list supports that version.
disputes.c: Our call: the nine above. Bowling and darts are NOT on the list.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.desc: Discover 100 vehicles.

steps.t: Drive, scan with WAiNK and sit in new vehicles; every new model discovered counts.
Only 100 of the 277 base models are needed here; 100% completion wants 200 of 277.
Scan vehicles from the start with the WAiNK app — it also feeds You WAiNKer! and the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach.

steps.t: Go to a bar overlooking Ocean Beach and order a cocktail; the trigger is still being confirmed by players.
Try it after reaching Vice City in Chapter 3, when Ocean Beach is open to explore.
No second source has pinned the exact bar or time of day yet — check back; this is one of 3 unconfirmed trophies.

disputes.a: KeenGamer: a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach; exact trigger still being confirmed.
disputes.b: WeHunt lists this among the five hidden trophies whose unlock method is still unknown.
disputes.c: Our call: unconfirmed. Do not chase it until a second source confirms the trigger.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.desc: Complete Chapter 2.

steps.t: Finish every Chapter 2 main mission, from What's in the Bag? to Checking Out.
Chapter 2 is where you meet Bret (Veteran Hunted) and Billy (Thrillbillies) — start their chains now.
The trophy pops at the end of Chapter 2; keep a manual save at the chapter start and end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.desc: Complete Chapter 3.

steps.t: Finish every Chapter 3 main mission, from Welcome to Vice City to The Cartel Heist.
Chapter 3 is where Andy, Tyrone and Yago's chains open — start all three the moment their icons appear.
The trophy pops at the end of Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.desc: Complete Breakfast Run.

steps.t: Play Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 (check on Jason); it pops when the mission ends.
Story mission trophies are unmissable — just play the story in order.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.desc: Complete The Cartel Heist.

steps.t: Play the Cartel Heist chain in Chapter 3: scope the Sinfrontera National Bank, run Security Expert, Company Property, Safe Word and Hidden Charges, then the heist itself.
The heist is the Chapter 3 finale; the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.

steps.t: In Chapter 3, Andy calls Lucia and texts an address in Belville — go there to start his strand (Lucia only).
Work through his five missions in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label.
Finish the last mission, Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse, to pop the trophy.
Jason cannot take Andy's missions — only Lucia can, so switch characters when Andy calls.

disputes.a: TechWiser (via eGamers): Stranger chains have windows tied to story progress — start them when they unlock.
disputes.b: PowerPyx walkthrough: all trophy-related Stranger questlines are still there after the story in free-roam.
disputes.c: Our call: start Andy's chain in Chapter 3 and finish it before the finale; free-roam is the fallback, not the plan.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps.t: In Chapter 3, play Here, Kitty Kitty as Jason to meet Tyrone.
Next, destroy the purple-marked Synthetic Labs sites for Take Out Kitty Litter (Kitty Litter Labs).
Finish Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs) to close his strand and pop the trophy.

disputes.a: TechWiser (via eGamers): Tyrone's chain has a window tied to story progress.
disputes.b: PowerPyx: Tyrone's questline stays available after the story in free-roam.
disputes.c: Our call: do Here, Kitty Kitty the moment it appears in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.t: In Chapter 2, play Veteran Hunted as Jason to meet Bret near Mount Kalaga.
Bret hands you hunting work: 15 Target Decks of animals to hunt across Leonida.
Hunt the unique animal Bret marks — shoot the head or heart so the carcass stays pristine.
One more unique animal waits in an Ammu-Nation locker; the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle is Bret's recommended tool.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: Bret's strand is Veteran Hunted plus 15 Target Decks; the unique-animal hunt pops Fair Game.
disputes.b: WeHunt: the exact hunt that pops Fair Game is still unconfirmed in detail.
disputes.c: Our call: finish all 15 Target Decks; the unique hunt is inside that work.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps.t: In Chapter 2, play Thrillbillies at the Mud Club to meet Billy.
Work his jobs in order: Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, then Mall Rats in Chapter 3.
Steal the Impaler for The Impaler, then finish Hometown Heroes to pop the trophy.

disputes.a: TechWiser (via eGamers): Billy's chain has a window tied to story progress.
disputes.b: PowerPyx: Billy's questline stays available after the story in free-roam.
disputes.c: Our call: start at the Mud Club in Chapter 2; do not leave the chain half-done.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps.t: In Chapter 3, take Randy's Wish List — a list of vehicles to steal and deliver.
Deliver every vehicle on the list; each delivery counts toward the 100 optional tasks too.
Finish the last delivery to close the strand and pop the trophy.

disputes.a: PowerPyx lists Randy's Wish List as the whole strand behind this trophy.
disputes.b: Other lists name the trophy without naming the mission — single-source on the detail.
disputes.c: Our call: the Wish List IS the strand; deliver them all.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps.t: In Chapter 1, play Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) to meet Kenton.
Kenton's treasure sets are the strand: find 5 of his 7 sets for the 100% checklist; his final mission closes the strand.
His sets hide underwater — 33 Underwater Discoveries feed the same hunt.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: Kenton has 7 treasure sets; 5 of 7 are needed for 100%.
disputes.b: Other lists name Kenton's final mission without tying it to the treasure sets.
disputes.c: Our call: work the treasure sets as you meet Kenton; the final mission follows.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

steps.t: Complete 8 qualifying strands. Counting ones: Kirk (Skunk Ape nights), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street races), Pilot Pete (The Last Mile) and four more marked in the guide.
Kirk's chain: Search for the Skunk Ape (Skunk Apeology 101, NIGHT ONLY), Search for Tree Effigies, then Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove (Lucia only, night only).
Yago's chain: Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother — do the race the moment it appears.
NOT counting: Shirley, Cal, Moses, Andy, Kenton, Billy, Tyrone, Eddie Acosta — they have their own trophies or none.
After each strand's last quest, check the trophy counter before and after — that is the only way to see which strands count.

disputes.a: WeHunt: skipping the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 may cost this trophy — a possible second missable.
disputes.b: PowerPyx walkthrough: time-sensitive optional missions do NOT affect trophies or 100% completion.
disputes.c: Our call: race Yago the moment the mission appears. The two sources disagree; the race costs nothing to do on time.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.desc: Complete 250 Stunts.

steps.t: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Stunt jumps per region: Mariana 17, Vice-Dale 55, Leonard 13, Kelly 29, Lummox 16.
Stunts get a map icon after you find them (Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots).
Track progress in Progress > Activities > Stunts; 300 of 397 are needed for 100%, only 250 for this trophy.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: 250 stunts for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants 300 of 397.
disputes.b: KeenGamer's cleanup step says 'at least 300 stunts' — that is the 100% number, not the trophy number.
disputes.c: Our call: 250 pops the trophy. Do 300 only if you are chasing A Long Road.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

steps.t: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations; each location also has 3 time trials (42 total).
All 42 Drone Time Trials are required for 100% completion, so gold them as you go.
Drone races open as you explore; check the Top Fun spots on the map per county.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.desc: Win 20 different races.

steps.t: Win 20 different races across Leonida's 40 unique races.
Race Challenge golds are separate: 10 of 13 gold medals are needed for 100%.
Yago's street races in Chapter 3 count toward the 20 — race him while his chain is open.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: 20 different races for the trophy; 30 of 40 won for 100%.
disputes.b: KeenGamer's roadmap counts 'win the required races' without splitting the two numbers.
disputes.c: Our call: 20 wins pop the trophy; 30 wins is the 100% line.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.t: Trigger Combat Focus (L3+R3) in a gunfight with at least 5 enemies in front of you.
Drop 5 enemies before Focus ends; Focus slows time, so line up headshots while it lasts.
Shooting Range challenges raise your Focus bar permanently, making this easier.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

steps.t: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape.
Do it in the countryside where cops are thin; a fast car and off-road escape help.
Your partner must be with you when the stars clear — do it during a duo mission if you can.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.t: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the Wanted Level ever clearing.
Pick 3 shops close together in Vice City and hit them fast, one after another.
Keep the heat on between shops — do not hide or wait it out.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.t: Rob a jewelry store (Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs chain in Chapter 3 shows you the stores) without any detection.
Go at night, move quietly, and leave before the alarm trips.
Sell the jewelry to Yasmani — fencing $100,000 of jewelry also feeds the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps.t: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and take the cash.
Escape with the Wanted Level still up — the escape is part of the trophy.
Armored trucks also feed the robbery totals on the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps.t: Rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs.
Gang Operations total 39 of 39 for 100% completion — do them all and this pops on the way.
Illegal Operations are marked as you explore; each gang's turf is a different county.

disputes.a: KeenGamer: rob at least one Illegal Operation per gang — nine gangs.
disputes.b: PowerPyx 100% guide: all 39 Gang Operations are required for 100%.
disputes.c: Our call: one per gang pops the trophy; all 39 is the 100% line.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport.

steps.t: Go to Vice City International Airport and wait for a passenger aircraft to start departing.
Board it as it taxis and take off with it — an unscheduled departure.
The VCIA Takedown mission chain in Chapter 4 teaches you the airport layout; use it first.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.desc: Complete Chapter 4.

steps.t: Finish every Chapter 4 main mission, from Ocean Beach to Starting From Zero.
Chapter 4 holds the VCIA Takedown heist and the Headliners and Child's Play missions — their trophies pop here.
The trophy pops at the end of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission.

steps.t: Play the Chapter 5 finale, The End of the Road, to the credits.
Free-roam continues after the story — everything for 100% is still available.
The 100% Completion Checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the credits.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.desc: Complete Child's Play.

steps.t: Play Child's Play in Chapter 4 (rescue Rafa from kidnappers).
Story mission trophies are unmissable — just play the story in order.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.desc: Complete Headliners.

steps.t: Play Headliners in Chapter 4 (help with the launch party).
Story mission trophies are unmissable — just play the story in order.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.desc: Complete VCIA Takedown.

steps.t: Play the VCIA Takedown chain in Chapter 4: Making Gainz, Blood Sweat and Gear, Too Much Baggage, Amateur Hour, Delivery Method, Team Building, Fully Catered, then the airport heist.
The trophy pops when the airport heist ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.desc: Complete Operation Savage Glory.

steps.t: Play Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Story mission trophies are unmissable — just play the story in order.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps.t: Two ranges only: Griffin Shooting Range in northwestern Vice City, and Rodgers Ranch northeast of Port Gellhorn.
At each range, buy the $5 Waiver Pass from the clerk first — only then do the challenges appear on the map.
Griffin has 6 moving courses × 3 gold tiers = 18 golds; play as Lucia, who moves faster.
Rodgers Ranch has 6 stationary score courses × 4 gold tiers = 24 golds; build the multiplier with body hits, finish with headshots.
No weapon owned? Rent one for $10 at the range; track golds in Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges.
42 golds total across 12 challenges — not 42 ranges. All 42 are required for 100% too.

disputes.a: GTADb: 12 challenges with tiered golds = 42 gold medals; Push Square lists 2 range locations.
disputes.b: Some lists say '42 Shooting Range locations' — wrong; there are 2 locations and 42 gold medals.
disputes.c: Our call: 2 ranges, 12 challenges, 42 golds. Griffin 18 + Rodgers Ranch 24.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.desc: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets.

steps.t: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets (480 cards total).
Cards hide indoors (desks, boards, rooftops) and outdoors (yellow phone boxes, toolboxes); small sets first: Backyard Wrestling has only 12 cards.
Cards can be sold at Pawn Shops ($20 to $1000+ by rarity) — but a sold card still counts once picked up.
Track sets in Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards; 15 sets are needed for 100%.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: 18 sets, 480 cards; 3 sets for the trophy, 15 for 100%.
disputes.b: GTADb: only 58 card spots are documented by name so far — the rest are still being mapped.
disputes.c: Our call: finish the 3 smallest sets first; the hunt is the same either way.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.desc: WAiNK It at 100 locations.

steps.t: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures across Leonida.
PowerPyx lists 31 WAiNK Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures — plus vehicles and animals scanned the same way.
Scan everything unfamiliar from Chapter 1 on; vehicles and animals count toward the 100% checklist too.
Filter the map: Map > Exploration, then WAiNK markers, to find unscanned spots.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: 31 landmarks + 35 curiosities + 23 sculptures = 89 named WAiNK spots.
disputes.b: The trophy wants 100 WAiNK scans — the extra 11 come from vehicles, animals and unlisted spots.
disputes.c: Our call: scan everything; the 100th scan pops the trophy before the named lists run out.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.desc: Complete 50 Challenges.

steps.t: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges in 8 categories of 10 (Combat, Criminal, Exploration, Fitness, Shopping, Sports, Survival, Vehicle).
Easy early ones: WAiNK 4 landmarks, score at 3 basketball hoops in a day, catch a 20-pound fish.
70 of 80 are needed for 100%, so you can skip the 10 hardest — including Legendary Hunter (kill all 8 unique animals).
Track them in Progress > Challenges; a checkmark shows in the bottom right when one is done.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: 50 challenges for the trophy, 70 of 80 for 100%.
disputes.b: KeenGamer's cleanup says '70 of the 80 Challenges' without splitting trophy vs 100%.
disputes.c: Our call: 50 pops the trophy; stop at 70 only for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.desc: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat.

steps.t: Steal a Rhino military tank from a military site, then use it in combat.
PowerPyx's how-to for the tank is 'How to Get Military Tank' in its wiki hub — check it before you drive in.
Expect a heavy Wanted response; the tank itself is the answer to that.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.desc: Explore all of Leonida.

steps.t: Unfog the whole map: drive, fly and sail every region of Leonida until no fog is left.
PowerPyx's 'How to Unfog the Map Fast (Best Plane)' is the fastest route — a plane beats a car here.
Exploring as you play the story unfogs most of it for free; clean up the corners after the credits.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.t: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts.
Marked Bills come from robberies; fence them through contacts, not shops.
The 100% checklist wants $250,000 of Marked Bills fenced — the same total, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.

disputes.a: KeenGamer: launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through contacts.
disputes.b: PowerPyx 100% guide: $250,000 Marked Bills FENCED — same total, different verb.
disputes.c: Our call: laundering through contacts IS the fencing the checklist counts.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.desc: Spend $100,000 across all shops.

steps.t: Spend a total of $100,000 across shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything sold in a store.
Weapons and cars are the fastest way to burn $100,000; garages do not count (they are properties).
Spending happens naturally across a 200-hour run; check the total before you start grinding it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.desc: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties.

steps.t: Buy all eight purchasable garage properties across Leonida.
Garages cost real money — robberies and fencing fund them; the Money Guide lists the fastest earners.
Each garage stores vehicles you register with the Scooter Bros app (see On the Spot).

disputes.a: KeenGamer: purchase all eight purchasable garage properties.
disputes.b: Some lists say 'all garage properties' without the count — eight is the confirmed number.
disputes.c: Our call: eight. Buy them all and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.t: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app.
Steal or buy 10 different vehicles, then register each one in the app.
Registered vehicles park in your garages — buy garages (Little Boxes) to keep them.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.desc: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia.

steps.t: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia.
Strength grows from melee, workouts and gym work; the VCIA Takedown chain's gym sessions (Blood Sweat and Gear) help.
PowerPyx's 'How to Increase Character Stats' guide covers the fastest Strength grind.

disputes.a: KeenGamer: maximize Strength for both characters.
disputes.b: WeHunt: the exact condition for Personal Best is still provisional.
disputes.c: Our call: max Strength on both; if it does not pop, the trigger detail is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.desc: Choices made (for better or worse).

steps.t: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile — robberies, crimes and choices that move the profile.
Turn on HUD notifications for the Criminal Profile so every action is visible as you play.
Ordinary play across 200 hours racks up hundreds; robberies and optional tasks push it over 500.

disputes.a: KeenGamer: perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile.
disputes.b: RadioTimes prints the description only — 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — with no number.
disputes.c: Our call: 500 actions; the profile counter in-game is the check.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.desc: Second time's the charm.

steps.t: No confirmed method yet: the name hints at failing once, then succeeding at the same thing.
Do not grind guesses — this is one of 3 unconfirmed trophies; wait for a second source.
Check back after more players finish the game; the method will be confirmed by the community.

disputes.a: RadioTimes: 'Second time's the charm.' — description only, no method.
disputes.b: WeHunt: one of five hidden trophies whose unlock method is still unknown.
disputes.c: Our call: unconfirmed. No method is offered here because none is verified.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.desc: Hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method.

steps.t: No confirmed method yet — the name points at the UFO/Aliens easter egg, but no source ties a trophy to it.
PowerPyx lists a UFO/Aliens Easter Egg in its Secrets section; it is an easter egg, not a confirmed trophy method.
Do not chase the UFO until a guide confirms the trigger — this is a dispute, not a method.

disputes.a: KeenGamer: hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method.
disputes.b: WeHunt: one of five hidden trophies whose unlock method is still unknown.
disputes.c: Our call: disputed, not unconfirmed-by-us — the UFO link is a guess, and we say so.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.desc: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape.

steps.t: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time.
The 8 large bank vaults unlock with the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 — wait for it.
All 8 vaults are required for 100%, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.

disputes.a: KeenGamer: 5 bank vaults for the trophy; 8 of 8 for 100%.
disputes.b: PowerPyx: the vaults unlock only after That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4.
disputes.c: Our call: do the Chapter 4 unlock mission first, then rob 5.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.desc: Perform the required melee drive-by elimination.

steps.t: Perform a melee drive-by elimination — a melee kill from a moving vehicle; the precise method is still being confirmed.
Try it from a slow car beside a pedestrian with a melee weapon out; do not rely on a single report.
This is a dispute, not a confirmed method — the community is still pinning it down.

disputes.a: KeenGamer: perform the required melee drive-by elimination; precise method still being confirmed.
disputes.b: WeHunt: one of five hidden trophies whose unlock method is still unknown.
disputes.c: Our call: disputed. The drive-by reading is the best report; it is not yet confirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.desc: Escape from a vehicle showroom.

steps.t: No confirmed method yet: the name points at escaping a vehicle showroom, likely during a robbery.
Do not grind guesses — this is one of 3 unconfirmed trophies; wait for a second source.
Check back after more players finish the game.

disputes.a: KeenGamer: escape from a vehicle showroom in the manner described by the trophy; exact method still unconfirmed.
disputes.b: WeHunt: one of five hidden trophies whose unlock method is still unknown.
disputes.c: Our call: unconfirmed. No method is offered here because none is verified.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Steal the three key valuables at Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and escape.

steps.t: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Vice City.
Steal the three key valuables inside, then escape the alley.
This is a bowling ALLEY robbery — it has nothing to do with the Master of None activity list.

disputes.a: KeenGamer: steal the three key valuables at the bowling alley and escape.
disputes.b: Other lists name the trophy without the location — single-source on the detail.
disputes.c: Our call: Kolt & Associates is the reported location; the three valuables are the target.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.desc: Attain 100% Completion.

steps.t: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list: 100 optional tasks, all robberies (39 Gang Ops, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loans, 8 vaults), 34/35 Smash 'N' Grabs, 50/91 Stick Ups.

Collectibles for 100%: 15/18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 30 magazines, 100/125 flamingos, 15/18 meditations, 5/7 Kenton sets, 200/277 vehicles, 50/66 weapons, 100/255 animals.
Activities for 100%: 30/40 races won, 10/13 race golds, 42/42 shooting golds, 42/42 drone trials, 300/397 stunts, 70/80 challenges, 15/15 Bret Target Decks.
Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can still be done after the story in free-roam.
It is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and collectibles are only partly required.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and KeenGamer: ~200 hours to platinum, hardest trophy is A Long Road.
disputes.b: Push Square: up to 300 hours or more; PowerPyx wiki: true 100% takes 300+ hours.
disputes.c: Our call: ~200 hours for the trophy checklist; 300+ is true completion, a different number.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.desc: Congratulations! You're a Leonida Legend.

steps.t: Earn every other trophy in the base game; this Platinum pops automatically when the 54th lands.
No online trophies, no DLC required, one playthrough is enough.
Hardest step is A Long Road (100% completion); the last trophy most players earn is a cleanup one, not a story one.
